title: Star Trek #3 Marvel 1980 The Motion Picture Adaptation Part 3 V'Ger Enterprise

Star Trek #3 (June 1980), Marvel Comics - Star Trek: The Motion Picture adaptation, part 3 of 3. V'Ger threatens Earth. Written by Marv Wolfman, art by Dave Cockrum and Klaus Janson. 40 cent cover price.
